key_patterns: Read tools are module-level @tool functions reading base URL + token from agent.config.settings and calling the shared seam agent.tools.http.make_request(base_url, token, endpoint=, params=, method=, body=, timeout=). make_request returns parsed JSON on 200/201 else {"error": "Request failed with status {code}: {text}"} and supports GET/POST/PUT ({"error": "Unsupported method: ..."} otherwise). Each service module exports a TOOLS list (e.g. JIRA_TOOLS). strands_agent.py builds READ_TOOLS = [*JIRA_TOOLS, ...] and passes tools=READ_TOOLS, hooks absent today. Tools return a formatted string and never raise; errors are surfaced as text. Unit tests monkeypatch make_request per module with a recording fake (_FakeRequest) and assert endpoint/params/body + byte-for-byte output; a second layer uses httpx.MockTransport on the real make_request. HITL mechanism (decided in task2-hitl-decision.md): native Strands interrupt via a BeforeToolCallEvent HookProvider â€” event.interrupt("write_approval", reason=proposal) raises InterruptException on first pass (stops loop, no body runs) and RETURNS the stored response on resume; on non-APPROVE the hook sets event.cancel_tool so the body never runs. Imports: from strands.hooks import BeforeToolCallEvent, HookProvider, HookRegistry. Resume driver re-invokes agent([{"interruptResponse": {"interruptId": itr.id, "response": "APPROVE"|"REJECT"}}]) and reads result.stop_reason=='interrupt' + result.interrupts.
